name: AtlasDeck Memory Bridge
description: Injects what AtlasDeck remembers into each turn and hands finished turns back to AtlasDeck so it can learn from every channel (Telegram, WhatsApp, web).

ownerSenderIds.description: If set, only these channel sender ids get memory context and capture.

channels.description: Channels where the bridge is active (default: telegram). Third-party channels like WhatsApp assessor mode must stay out.
